environment: Linux / Python 3.12.14 / pinned project dependencies / Qt offscreen / Matplotlib Agg

reliability_tests.clean_restore: Exact SQL dump equality, including every BLOB and metadata; inputs, parameters, manual correction, report and legacy attachment reopened twice after deletion of the original archive
reliability_tests.wal: Committed WAL data included; concurrent uncommitted transaction excluded
reliability_tests.corruption: Payload checksum failure rejects copy and cleans temporary file
reliability_tests.migration_validation: Unknown migrations and modified checksums rejected without publication
reliability_tests.upgrade: Stage 7 schema 001 copied unchanged; restored copy upgraded to 002; existing well preserved
reliability_tests.failed_upgrade: Injected SQL failure publishes no destination and preserves the backup
reliability_tests.writer_lock: Second writer rejected with bounded busy timeout; first transaction rolled back; retry and reopening succeed
reliability_tests.abrupt_exit: Separate process exits inside a transaction; reopening recovers only committed data and permits new writes

gui_recovery.snapshot: Restore into a new directory; exact signals, statistics, automatic and corrected tables, correction history, intervals and saved widget state; no recalculation
gui_recovery.report: DOCX generated from restored GUI state; embedded report copied and restored byte-for-byte
gui_recovery.versions: New calculation creates a new version; older result remains available

headless: Both examples processed without Qt; existing unit contracts enforce no intermediate file writes and no database requirement in the analysis core

performance.status: PASS all provisional engineering budgets on supplied examples
performance.method: Medians measured without concurrent test processes, warm process/cache; no optimization or tolerance changes

wheel: PASS built offline with system setuptools; new module and both migrations included; three launchers, backup/restore API and all CLI operations tested from foreign CWD without Qt for recovery operations
